morse.label.code: Morse code — space between letters, / between words
morse.status.idle: Type in either box and the other follows.
morse.status.koNote: Hangul is sent letter by letter (jamo).
morse.status.unknown: Some symbols are not in the table, so they became ?.
morse.status.readKo: Decoded. Hangul Morse sends only the jamo, so some readings are ambiguous (어쓰 vs 엇스).
